text.tspan: - 400 MHz signal processing pipeline (8 ADC samples/clock)
- Embedded waveform generator for testiing (buffer playback, noise generator, test patterns)
- 16-bit real gain for each of the 8192 bins, plus common post-scaling factor prior to (4+4) bit conversoin
- (4+4) bits N2 correlator on all channels. (18+18) bits integrated products.
- Periodic pre-FFT, or post-FFT and post-scaler periodic raw data capture
- Data offload of raw data and correlatorproducts to Zynq processor via direct memory access
